templates.name: Process
templates.hint: Steps in a row, start to done.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Start"])
  B["Step one"]
  C["Step two"]
  D["Step three"]
  E(["Done"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C --> D
  D --> E

templates.name: Decision
templates.hint: One question with a yes and a no.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Start"])
  B{"Is it ready?"}
  C["Go ahead"]
  D["Fix what is missing"]
  E(["Done"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"Yes"| C
  B -->|"No"| D
  D -.-> B
  C --> E

templates.name: Approval
templates.hint: A request, two reviews and a way back.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Submit request"])
  B{"Manager review"}
  C{"Finance review"}
  D(["Approved"])
  E["Revise the request"]
  A --> B
  B -->|"Approved"| C
  B -->|"Changes needed"| E
  C -->|"Approved"| D
  C -->|"Changes needed"| E
  E -.-> A

templates.name: Onboarding
templates.hint: From sign up to a first win.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Sign up"])
  B["Confirm email"]
  C("Set up a profile")
  D{"Pick a plan"}
  E["Free tour"]
  F["Add payment"]
  G(["First task done"])
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C --> D
  D -->|"Free"| E
  D -->|"Paid"| F
  E --> G
  F --> G

templates.name: Bug triage
templates.hint: Reproduce it, rate it, then fix or park it.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  A(["Bug reported"])
  B{"Can you reproduce it?"}
  C["Ask for details"]
  D{"How bad is it?"}
  E["Fix now"]
  F["Add to the backlog"]
  G["Verify the fix"]
  H(["Closed"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"No"| C
  C -.-> B
  B -->|"Yes"| D
  D -->|"Critical"| E
  D -->|"Minor"| F
  E --> G
  G --> H
  F --> H

templates.name: User flow
templates.hint: A visitor from the landing page to a result.
templates.source:
flowchart LR
  A(["Landing page"])
  B{"Signed in?"}
  C["Sign in"]
  D("Dashboard")
  E["Create an item"]
  F(["See the result"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"No"| C
  C --> D
  B -->|"Yes"| D
  D --> E
  E --> F

templates.name: Swimlanes
templates.hint: Who does what, one lane for each team.
templates.source:
flowchart TD
  subgraph G1 ["Customer"]
    A(["Place an order"])
    F(["Order arrives"])
  end
  subgraph G2 ["Warehouse"]
    B["Receive the order"]
    C{"In stock?"}
    D["Pack and ship"]
  end
  subgraph G3 ["Support"]
    E["Tell the customer"]
  end
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|"Yes"| D
  C -->|"No"| E
  D --> F

templates.name: Blank

templates.name: Brainstorm
templates.hint: A mind map with an idea in the middle and branches around it.
templates.source:
mindmap
  root(("Project idea"))
    n1["Goals"]
      n2["What done looks like"]
      n3["Who it is for"]
    n4["People"]
      n5["Who helps"]
      n6["Who decides"]
    n7["Risks"]
      n8["What could go wrong"]
    n9["Next steps"]

templates.name: Project plan
templates.hint: Periods and what happens in each, grouped in sections.
templates.source:
timeline
  title Project plan
  section Plan
    Week 1 : Kick off : Agree the goal
    Week 2 : First draft
  section Build
    Week 3 : Review
    Week 4 : Ship

templates.name: Sign in
templates.hint: A user, an app and a server, with a yes and a no.
templates.source:
sequenceDiagram
  actor U as User
  participant A as App
  participant S as Server
  U->>A: Enter email and password
  A->>S: Check the details
  alt Details match
    S-->>A: Signed in
    A-->>U: Show the home page
  else Details do not match
    S-->>A: Refuse
    A-->>U: Show the error
  end

templates.name: Request and reply
templates.hint: A client asks, a server looks it up, the answer comes back.
templates.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as Server
  participant D as Database
  C->>S: Ask for the page
  S->>D: Look up the data
  D-->>S: Return the rows
  S-->>C: Send the page
  Note over C,S: The client waits for the reply
